title: TrustAgent API v1 payloads (REST and WebSocket v2)
description: Contract-owned JSON Schema for the TrustAgent REST and WebSocket v2 payloads (docs/v2/SPEC.md sections 2.1, 2.4, 2.5 and 2.6). Every $defs entry has the name, fields and enum values of the same type in frontend-react/src/types/api.ts; Go handler tests and the golden fixtures in contracts/fixtures/api/ validate against 'api.v1.schema.json#/$defs/<TypeName>'. It covers the S0 core (health and status, traces (list and detail), gate decisions, audits with claims and UTF-16 spans, the WebSocket v2 envelope and events, and the error body) and the P4 surfaces (settings, credentials, Connect OpenRouter, API keys and the admin audit log; ROI and pricing; evaluator writes, Studio, labels, calibration, evidence suggestions and the decision request).
$comment: Generated from api.ts with ts-json-schema-generator 2.9.0 (--type '*' --expose export --jsDoc extended, plus a scratch type instantiating Page<TraceSummary>, Page<GateDecisionRow>, Page<AuditSummary> and Page<AdminAuditEntry>), converted from draft-07 to 2020-12 (definitions -> $defs; array-form items -> prefixItems) and pruned to the roots named in the description plus everything they reference. Page<T> keeps the generator's name, percent-encoded in $ref. Regenerate instead of hand-editing whenever api.ts changes.

ApiErrorBody.description: REST error body for every `/api/*` error (`/v1/*` errors use the upstream API's shape).

BindingTarget.description: What a credential write or a verify may bind (D75): never the upstreams, which bind through PATCH.

activate.description: The adopt flow fits with activate:false, previews, then activates (D62).

CalibrationRecommended.description: Recommended thresholds in calibrated space (calibration.v1 recommended).

ClaimVerdict.description: Claim verdict (proto-mirrored, UPPER_SNAKE). NOT_CHECKED is excluded from all aggregates.

span.description: Claim location in the answer text: UTF-16 code units, half-open; null when unaligned.

stored.description: false when a failed verification left the currently bound key in place.

verification.description: null when the write asked for verify:false.

return_to.description: A dashboard path under /app/ to return to.

CreatedApiKey.description: The created key: secret is shown once and never again.

CredentialPutRequest.description: PUT /api/credentials/:name (#55). base_url only for compatible and upstream-* (D29).

verify.description: Default true; bind with verify:false is a 422 (D75).

CredentialVerification.description: The result of checking a key with its provider (D40). The secret never appears here.

hint.description: A code the web renders words for (e.g. no_credits), or null.

key_label.description: OpenRouter GET /api/v1/key: the key's label and spending limit (null = no limit).

CredentialWriteResult.description: #55, #57 and #59 (D75): one shared write; bindings apply only when verification.ok.

stored.description: false when a failed verification left the currently bound key in place.

verification.description: null when the write asked for verify:false.

DetectorFinding.description: Detector hit in the answer text: UTF-16 code units, half-open; -1 means unaligned.

EvaluatorValidateResult.description: Schema errors and lints (Go internal/decision/lint.go is the reference, D54); hashes are null while errors remain.

EvaluatorVersionCreateRequest.description: POST /api/evaluators/:id/versions (#32): base_version is the latest version the editor started from.

EvidenceSpan.description: Where a claim's support sits in evidence document `doc_index`; UTF-16 code units, half-open.

code.description: A machine code the web renders words for, e.g. reenter_secret (P4 D37) or fallback_key_required (D41).

HealthStatus.description: GET /health (SPEC §2.4 endpoint 1): public liveness. `audit_engine` is the cached result of the real engine ping, not merely "a client exists". SPEC §2.6 leaves this shape unnamed; the name is added here so the schema can describe it.

JevRequest.description: One decision-model request body as compiled (session_id is never returned).

LabelValue.description: <id>@<v> takes should_fire|should_not_fire; claim:<i> a claim verdict; response hallucinated|grounded (D59).

Page<AdminAuditEntry>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

Page<AuditSummary>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

Page<GateDecisionRow>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

Page<TraceSummary>.description: Keyset page (`limit` 1-200, default 50, plus `cursor`); `next_cursor` is null at the end.

RuntimeSettingsPatch.description: PATCH /api/settings body (#53): any subset of RuntimeSettings, nested objects partial too.

StatusWarning.description: A status or settings warning with details (P4 D32, D77): the web renders words by code.

cost_source.description: P4 D82: simulated for a mock judge, so the draft cost is labelled Simulated.

runtime_config_epoch.description: P4 D34: the Go settings epoch of the last push the engine applied.

warning_details.description: P4: the warnings that carry details (master_key_changed, fail_closed_unprotected, ...); codes also appear in warnings.

TraceId.description: Server-generated UUIDv7. Legacy rows keep trace_id = audit_id.

names.description: master_key_changed, reenter_secret: the credential names (D32, D37).

routes.description: fail_closed_unprotected, confirmation_required: the enforcing routes affected (D77).

WsEvent.description: One WS v2 text frame (one JSON object per frame; negotiate with `GET /ws?protocol=2`). `seq` is assigned by the hub and is only comparable within one `epoch`. `hb` frames carry no `seq` and no `data`.

WsTicket.description: POST /api/ws-ticket (#7, D71): a one-use ticket for ?ticket= on the WebSocket URL.
